newsitem.title: QATAR: GOLF-QATAR TO STAGE PGA EVENT.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-QATAR TO STAGE PGA EVENT.

text.p: The Gulf state of Qatar will stage its own professional golf tournament in 1998 under a deal signed on Wednesday by the European Professional Golfers' Association (PGA) and the head of the Qatar Golf Association.
The $1 million Qatar Masters will take place from March 9 to 12 1998 and will form part of the lucrative European tour sanctioned by the PGA.
The agreement was signed in the Qatari capital Doha by Ken Schofield, executive director of the European PGA, and Tami al-Hajri, president of the Qatar Golf Association.
